name: CPoE Evidence Packet Profile
description: Verification requirements for a CPoE (Cryptographic Proof of Effort) evidence packet, as referenced by the `profile_uri` field (CDDL key 2) of an EvidencePacketWire.

timestampBinding.mechanism: RFC 9921 COSE header parameter for RFC 3161 timestamp tokens

notes: Published under this domain because urn:ietf:params: is IANA-controlled and this profile was never IETF-WG-adopted; a dereferenceable URI needs no registration.
